{{Quote|Droid services|Business sign|<ref name="SW" />}}
'''Repair Rack''' was the name of a business at the [[Orondia Refueling Station]]<ref name="SW" /> and [[Stobar Spaceport]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Brothers" /> According to the [[Aurebesh]] signage, Repair Rack offered "[[droid]] services."<ref name="SW" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Signage at the fueling station includes: Eat at Koe's, Bounty Emporium: Always Open, Bounty Never Sleeps; Security Services; Speeder Sales; The Pilot's Lounge (Live Band Every Night); Craft Repair and Maintenance; Repair Rack Droid Services; Orondia Tours; and Meteor Cafe.|StarWars.com Trivia Gallery for "Friends and Enemies"|<ref name="SW" />}}
The name and logo for the business was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Friends and Enemies]]," as one of several advertisements present at the [[Orondia Refueling Station]].<ref name="SW" /> However, although the ad is seen, it is unreadable in the final episode.<ref name="Friends">{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}}</ref>
